test_title: SSC Stenographer 2025 Official Paper (Held On: 06 Aug, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the correct passive form of the given sentence.

"They serve food to the guests."

options.text: Food Is served to the guests by them
Food was served to the guests.
Food is being served by them.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Passive voice structure: The object of the active voice sentence becomes the subject of the passive voice sentence.
 
• In the active voice, the sentence is: "They serve food to the guests."
 
• To convert to passive voice: Place the object "food" at the beginning.
 
• Change the active verb form "serve" to "is served" (present simple passive).
 
• Add the preposition "by" followed by the original subject "them."
 
• Ensure that the phrase "to the guests" remains in the sentence for clarity.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2: **"Food was served to the guests." – Incorrect because the tense changes to past simple.
 
• **Option 3: **"Food is being served by them." – Incorrect because the tense changes to present continuous.
 
• **Option 4: **"Food has served by them." – Incorrect because of incorrect verb form.
